name: Joe Woods

views.text: A good scouting process is a staff-wide effort, from the combine to the last visit.
Working under another play-caller is a chance to learn how a different coach thinks.
A defense can lead the league against the pass and still lose games if it cannot stop the run late.
Defensive backs are built through technique and film, and the great ones keep asking questions.
When a locker-room complaint goes public, you deal with it inside the building.
When the head coach leaves mid-season, the coordinator's job is to keep the defense steady.

signatures: talks about the draft and scouting process with real enthusiasm
frames a smaller role as a chance to learn rather than a step down
want: to rebuild his reputation as a defensive coordinator after his Cleveland exit
fear: that a run defense that fades late in the year becomes the lasting story of his career
voice: Plain-spoken and good-humored in the few interviews he gives, he sounds comfortable as a trusted right-hand man. He talks about process and learning more than about himself and avoids public friction. Coverage of him in New Orleans is thin.

evidence.summary: Cleveland fires him after three seasons and a 7-10 year; his defense was mid-pack, a public dispute with Clowney over the scheme ended with Clowney sent home, and several players had voiced frustration. Stefanski says the unit fell short. Results and controversy, not his voice.
Hiring report: Browns DC 2020-2022 whose first year included a playoff win, Denver DC 2017-2018, and Raiders DB coach in 2014 when Allen was head coach, the link behind the reunion. Background.

Explains Allen stays play-caller and designer with Woods as right-hand man; notes Woods coached defensive backs like Woodson, Harrison Smith and Antoine Winfield and led San Francisco's top pass defense as DB coach in 2019. Local analysis.

Woods calls the Saints' draft process the best he has seen, welcomes a coordinator role without play-calling as a chance to learn another coach's approach while sharing ideas, and recalls working with Allen in Oakland. His words.
After Allen's firing, interim coach Rizzi hands Woods the defensive play-calling for the rest of 2024; the defense ranked 28th in points allowed. Mentions him only briefly.
